query:
SELECT attempts >= $4
               OR failed_at + make_interval(
                    secs => greatest(
                        $3,
                        least(
                            21600.0::float8,
                            60.0::float8 * power(4.0::float8, least(attempts - 1, 8)::float8)
                        )
                    )
                  ) > now() AS "cooling!"
        FROM media_fetch_failures
        WHERE kind = $1 AND target_id = $2
